title: Being “Lukewarm” Is More Dangerous Than Cold
paragraphs: Being “Lukewarm” Is More Dangerous Than Cold
You still believe in God.
But you don’t burn for Him.
That is the terrifying part.
Jesus said:
“Because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of my mouth.” — Revelation 3:16
Read that again.
He wasn’t talking to atheists.
He was talking to people who thought they were fine.

You pray when life gets hard.
You worship when it feels emotional.
You repent just enough to feel clean…
then return to the same sin when nobody is watching.
God saw it.
You knew.
But here’s what most people don’t realize…
Cold people know they are far from God.
Lukewarm people are deceived into thinking distance is devotion.

They have church language but no surrender.
Conviction but no obedience.
A Bible app but no hunger.
Tears at the altar but secret chains at home.
Jesus said:
“This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.” — Matthew 15:8
That is the diagnosis.
Not weakness only.
Divided worship.
But the Gospel is not God saying, “Try harder.”
The Gospel is Jesus stepping into the graveyard of your compromise and saying:
“Repent, and believe in the gospel.” — Mark 1:15

Your sin is real.
Your rebellion is exposed.
Your excuses are finished.
But grace is still calling.
“By grace you have been saved through faith… not a result of works.” — Ephesians 2:8–9
Jesus did not die to make you religious.
He died to make you new.
Originally written by Gospel Warrior.
So today, choose.

Not image.
Not comfort.
Not half-surrender.
Christ.
